Delete this PO?
This removes the PO from all lists. If it came from a request, the request goes back to "Approved" so a new PO can be made. The deletion is recorded with your name and reason.
Send PO to vendor
The PO PDF downloads first. Attach it to the email or WhatsApp message that opens, then send. The PO is marked "Sent to vendor" with today's date.

GRNs created

Returnable challans

Material sent out for job work, repair or trial. Stays open until all of it is received back.

Job work inward (customer material)

Material a customer sends in on their challan for job work. Bill it from Tax invoices > New invoice > Job work.

Job work desk

Customer material that came in for job work: record it, send it back with the invoice, and see what is still to bill.

Stock register

Accepted GRN quantities come in automatically. Issues to a mould or project take stock out at the average rate; returns put it back.

Issue and return slips

Material cost by project

PO value is what was ordered for the job (before GST). Net issued is material issued from store less returns, at average rate.

GRNs to book

Vendor payments

Outstanding is booked GRN value less payments made. Pick a supplier to record a payment or see their ledger.

Booked and paid GRNs

Debit notes to suppliers

For material rejected or returned, rate differences or short supply. Pick the GRN and the lines fill in. Returns after acceptance reduce what you owe and take the quantity out of stock.
Delay = date the PO was closed (final GRN) minus the date the requester needed the material. Open items past their required date count as running late.

Users

Add each person with their department and job. That is all: the job gives them the right screens. Pick a plant to have it filled in on every new request, PO, challan, invoice and other document they make; they can still change it on the document. Can see decides whether they see only their own plant or both plants. Admin and Director always see both; Accounts, Purchase and HR see both unless you change it; everyone else sees their own plant.
Staff: only asks for material (their request goes to their department head). · Department head: approves requests from their department. · Purchase: the buyer. Gets approved requests, makes pre-estimates and POs, sends POs to vendors. · Store: receives material, issues stock. · Accounts: books bills and payments. · Sales: enquiries, quotations, orders, invoices. · Production: job cards. · Director: approves and signs POs, sees everything. · Admin: sets up the app.

Sales orders

Make a sales order from a won quotation (open it on the Sales page), or start one here. Challans and invoices are made from the order, so you can see what is still to dispatch and bill.

Delivery challans

Open a sales order and press "Make challan" to send part or all of it. Pending quantity is tracked per line.

Tax invoices

Start a new invoice from a sales order, a customer PO, job work on customer material, or direct. You can also make one from a challan. GST is CGST + SGST for Maharashtra customers (GSTIN starting 27) and IGST for others. Record payments received to track what is still to collect.

Job board

Each mould or job has one job card with its operations. Mark operations Running and Done as work moves. Completed shows the last 60 days.

Machine load

Planned hours not yet done, by machine.

Running now

Credit notes to customers

For sales returns, rate differences or discounts after billing. Open an invoice and press "Credit note" to fill the lines. Credit notes reduce what the customer owes and go into the e-invoice export.

Suppliers

The state is read from the first two digits of the GSTIN (27 is Maharashtra, so CGST + SGST; any other state gets IGST). Each supplier gets a code (S0001, S0002 …) when it is added; a code that came with imported data is kept. A code is never given to a second party, even after a supplier is removed.

Items

Import your Item & Service Master workbook (ITEM MASTER and SERVICE MASTER sheets are both read), or a product list exported from your old ERP. Columns are matched by their headings and you see a preview, with missing codes, HSN/SAC and GST flagged, before anything is saved. "Download list" gives the same two-sheet layout back. Item names then show up as suggestions on requests, estimates, POs and sales documents.
